appDescription: A vehicle maintenance log that helps users record service history and review upcoming maintenance.

function.name: ADD_MAINTENANCE_RECORD
function.description: Open a draft maintenance record for the user to review and save in the app.

item.description: The maintenance item or service mentioned by the user.

date.description: The maintenance date in YYYY-MM-DD format if explicitly provided or clearly determined.

costWon.description: The maintenance cost in Korean won if provided.

function.name: GET_MAINTENANCE_RECORD
function.description: Find the latest saved maintenance record for a named item.

item.description: The maintenance item to look up.

function.name: GET_MAINTENANCE_DUE
function.description: Check saved maintenance items that are due or upcoming, based on recorded intervals and available vehicle mileage.
